Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Sipple, George <gsipple@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, March 31, 2016 4:58 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: dogs JV
“I’ve got my dog. I’ve got Kate’s dog. Not to mention when I leave for the season, my parents take my dog. I can’t get another and just plop it on them to watch during the season.
But a lot of great dogs. They told me after the game, there were seven adopted today. And they expect a lot more. Obviously a lot of people come and see the dogs who can’t adopt them here.
The end goal is just to make people happy. Make dogs people. Make people happy. Man’s best friend, you know?”
